title: Greta Gerwig's Narnia trailer is out and fans are split over how it looks
dek: The first trailer for Netflix's Narnia film drew some of the biggest film posts of the week, with praise and complaints about the same images.
what: Netflix and the film's account posted a promotional video for Narnia: The Magician's Nephew on October 13, and the account DiscussingFilm said the first trailer had been released. What's on Netflix reports it premiered that day at an IMAX event in New York. Greta Gerwig directs. The film opens in theaters on February 12, 2027 and arrives on Netflix on April 2, 2027, according to that report.

What's on Netflix also reports that Gerwig said she built the film from C.S. Lewis's writing and that Led Zeppelin allowed "Stairway to Heaven" in it, which the site says the band had long refused to license.

The same report says reactions split. Some called it "the best trailer I've seen in years" and liked its glam-rock, psychedelic look. Others said the colourful, effects-heavy look resembled a Marvel film, and some objected to changes from the book.
I only read that report, not the trailer's full coverage by other outlets, and counted no reactions myself. The split is described from the posts below and that report.
why: Narnia is a book series many people know from childhood, and the trailer is the first look at how it will be changed. People post their own version of what the story should look like.

worlds.name: Fans who liked it
worlds.sees: One viewer calls a shot from the trailer a favourite and praises the director's mind. Others quoted in the report called it the best trailer in years.

worlds.name: Fans of the books who object
worlds.sees: A film that changes too much of Lewis's work, with magic and effects that do not fit what they remember. Some ask why it was not made as a new story.

common: Established: the trailer came out on October 13, and the release dates above come from What's on Netflix's report. A trailer shows only part of a film. Whether the finished film keeps or changes the book cannot be judged from it. Both groups are reacting to the same trailer, and neither group's description can be checked against the film yet.
